description: This file defines the NotPositiveException class, which extends NumberIsTooSmallException, to represent an exception thrown when a given number argument is not positive (zero or negative). It includes constructors for default and localized error messages.

classes.name: NotPositiveException
classes.description: An exception indicating that a number argument was not positive (zero or negative). It extends NumberIsTooSmallException to specify the value and the zero boundary.

methods.name: NotPositiveException
methods.description: Constructor for instances with a given number value.
